test_cases.name: resolves_session_intent_without_asking
assertions: Uses the intent accepted in this session without asking and states its path in one line
Does NOT list intent files when the session already produced one

test_cases.name: lists_intents_when_nothing_resolves
assertions: Lists .physarum/docs/intents/*-intent.md and asks which one
Does NOT guess an intent

test_cases.name: stops_when_intent_not_accepted
assertions: Reads the intent from disk instead of relying on memory of its Status
Stops and says the PO must accept it first, suggesting /intent to revise the draft
Does NOT invoke brainstorming

test_cases.name: no_intent_file_suggests_intent
test_cases.input: /spec làm tính năng export CSV (chưa có intent nào)
assertions: Stops and suggests /intent
Does NOT write a spec

test_cases.name: brainstorming_architectural_path_no_reask
assertions: Invokes superpowers:brainstorming with the intent as the brief on the architectural path
Does NOT re-ask Problem, Proposed outcome, Constraints, or Out of scope
Writes .physarum/docs/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md reusing the intent's date+topic stem
Does NOT reclassify to bounded or spike

test_cases.name: ui_spec_gets_design_section_before_review
test_cases.input: /spec intent mô tả một trang và một sheet mới trong web app
assertions: Treats the spec as a UI spec and follows the Design contract at the end of .agents/.commands/spec.md
Follows its Design contract and Spec stage so ## Design is in the spec before the step 5 report
Asks only what ## Design still needs

test_cases.name: non_ui_spec_skips_design
test_cases.input: /spec intent chỉ đổi validation của một endpoint API
assertions: Skips the UI check step
Does NOT add a ## Design section

test_cases.name: report_uses_fixed_template
assertions: Reports with the fixed lines in order: Spec written, Intent, Approach, Design, Decisions, ADR check, Agent calls, Open questions
Does NOT ask 'approved?' separately before the three options
Does NOT commit

test_cases.name: ends_with_three_options_in_fixed_order
test_cases.input: /spec (spec vừa viết xong, intent Class T3 đổi schema)
assertions: Ends the reply with exactly three options in order: option 1 is the command named by ADR check, option 2 is the other of /adr and /plan, option 3 is Tiny/Quick: accept and /implement
Marks option 1 (Recommended) with a one-line reason, here /adr
Option 3's description says it skips /adr and /plan
Does NOT pick an option silently

test_cases.name: adr_check_recommends_plan_when_no_adr_worthy_decision
test_cases.input: /spec (spec ghi 'No ADR needed' trong ## Decisions, Class T1)
assertions: ADR check line says plan with a reason
Option 1 is Accept and /plan (Recommended) and option 2 is Accept and /adr

test_cases.name: adr_check_recommends_adr_for_hard_to_reverse_tradeoff
test_cases.input: /spec (Class T1 nhưng approach chọn một quyết định khó đảo ngược, gây bất ngờ khi thiếu context, có đánh đổi thật)
assertions: ADR check line says adr citing the three writing-adr tests
Option 1 is Accept and /adr (Recommended) and option 2 is Accept and /plan

test_cases.name: option_accept_sets_status_and_runs_command
assertions: Sets the spec Status to approved with a name and today's date
Runs /plan with the spec path
Does NOT invoke writing-plans directly

When Class is T3, the spec records an architecture change, or ADR check found a decision passing the writing-adr filter, and ## Decisions has no outcome, and the user picks /plan, writes the line `ADR skipped by user`

test_cases.name: option_tiny_quick_accept_and_implement
assertions: Sets the spec Status to approved
Sets the intent to Class: T0 with Lane /implement → /verify → /ship and adds 'Class set by originator' to Signals
Runs /implement with the intent path
Does NOT run /adr or /plan

test_cases.name: free_text_answer_is_change_request
test_cases.input: /spec (user answers Other: 'đổi tên nút thành Create repo')
assertions: Edits the spec and repeats the report and the three options
Does NOT approve the spec
Does NOT run any next command

test_cases.name: ui_design_records_thesis_and_sketch
test_cases.input: /spec intent mô tả một form mới trong web app
assertions: ## Design has a Thesis slot (reading path, what leads and supports, what groups and separates) and a Sketch slot (desktop and 390px) written before Structure
Structure agrees with the Sketch
Acceptance checks include at least one hierarchy check (squint test) taken from Thesis

test_cases.name: mirrors_screenshot_not_taken_is_stated
test_cases.input: /spec (UI spec, browser busy so the Mirrors screen cannot be screenshotted)
assertions: The Mirrors slot says `not taken — <reason>` instead of staying silent
The step 5 report line `Design:` says the Mirrors screenshot was not taken
Does NOT claim a screenshot that was not taken
